text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to find patterns. This data includes examples with correct answers, like emails marked as spam or not spam. The computer builds a model from these examples. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For instance, it can guess whether a new email is spam. Accuracy shows how often these predictions are correct. A good model usually has high accuracy, meaning it makes the right prediction most of the time.
